title: Heatmap bins
description: How many columns the 0–512 playfield is split into. Fewer bins read as broad zones, more show fine positioning. Changes apply to the whole attempt instantly.

title: Colour intensity
description: Brightness curve of the heat colours, 0.25–4. 1 is linear; higher values lift rarely visited zones, lower values keep only the hottest spots bright. Bar heights stay linear.

title: Show catcher marker
description: Draw the live catcher (true catch range for the map's CS, filled while dashing) and its position line during play.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Show the 18—LAB tag in the panel header.
